## Meta Pricing Updates

Meta commercial costs are usually tied to advertising spend, business messaging usage, API access, and campaign management services rather than traditional software licensing.

## Key Price Changes
- Ads: Spend efficiency depends on targeting, creative quality, auction dynamics, and conversion tracking
- WhatsApp Business: Pricing can vary by conversation type, geography, and messaging volume
- Developer/API access: Terms depend on product, usage, and compliance requirements

## Business Impact
- Ad costs can fluctuate based on auction competition and privacy-driven signal loss
- Business messaging can scale customer engagement but needs usage governance
- Brand safety and measurement quality affect ROI

## What This Means
- Negotiate agency/platform support tied to performance KPIs
- Monitor WhatsApp Business conversation costs and opt-in quality
- Require clear measurement, attribution, and brand safety controls
